content:
Allison Grant: quick q on internal unit econ page defaults. seeing dogfood folks (esp Finance) landing on weird comparisons bc the filter state persists from last session. what are we defaulting to for v1?

Chloe Martin: current implementation is localStorage restore if present, else default: last 7d, all models, all regions, all tiers. compare mode off.

Laura Bennett: all tiers + last 7d is fine for Eng, but for Finance it’s almost never what we want. we keep getting screenshots where someone is looking at “last 7d” but talking about QTD.

Rishi Malhotra: +1. and the other trap is “compare vs previous period” when the rate card version changed mid-window. people think cost went up, but it’s a rate card refresh.

Marissa Cole: can we support “saved views” like: “Finance QTD (Reporting)” and “Eng Live (last 24h)”? even if it’s internal-only and hardcoded / not user-generated yet.

Felix Schneider: we can do saved views but need to decide where it lives. easiest: server-provided presets (no personal saved views) + a “reset to default” button.

Alicia Perez: UX wise, I’d prefer:
- landing default = “Company (Live)” (simple)
- presets dropdown = “Finance QTD (Reporting)”, “SRE Freshness Check”, etc
- always show the active preset label if you used one
- and a conspicuous “You have modified this view” indicator when filters diverge

Nora Ahmed: right now we show just the filter pills, so it’s not obvious when you’re in a mutated state. adding a “modified” chip is doable.

Talia Benson: reminder from kickoff notes: Finance asked for “QTD by default” *for Finance users*, but we said RBAC-based defaults might be v1.1. if we can ship presets now, that may be the compromise.

Dylan Brooks: prefer not to fork defaults by user role in v1. it’s a slippery slope + more bugs. presets are ok.

Mei Lin: on the data side, QTD also has timezone expectations. if someone selects “QTD” we need to define “day boundary” (UTC vs Finance reporting timezone). otherwise it won’t reconcile.

Rishi Malhotra: Finance reporting is US/Pacific day boundary for now (don’t ask 😅). but for the dashboard we can call it out explicitly: “QTD (PT)”.

Allison Grant: love explicit labeling. reduces pager noise too when folks think data is missing bc it’s “today” but they’re looking at PT boundary.

Chloe Martin: we can add a time range option “Quarter-to-date (PT)” and “Quarter-to-date (UTC)”? or just one?

Laura Bennett: please don’t add two unless you have to. in exec reporting, it’s PT. engineering can still use last 24h/7d.

Marissa Cole: proposal:
1) Default landing (no preset selected) = Last 7 days, PT day boundary label in tooltip? (or just show timezone somewhere)
2) Preset: “Finance QTD (PT, Rate card locked)”
3) Preset: “Eng Live (Last 24h, includes partial hours)”
4) Preset: “SRE: Last 6h freshness check”

Felix Schneider: “rate card locked” implies the view uses the versioned rate card + a consistent allocation snapshot. we can do that if the API supports it (separate “finance view” endpoint vs “live”). we already discussed separate views in the caching vs freshness thread.

Mei Lin: yep, in warehouse we can expose:
- live_mv (hourly, may change w/ late data)
- finance_mv (same aggregates but pinned to allocation_snapshot_id + rate_card_version)
then preset chooses which backing view.

Rishi Malhotra: +1. Finance preset should use the pinned view. otherwise the number changes after close and we have to explain it.

Nora Ahmed: UI guardrail: when compare mode is enabled, we should show a small callout: “Comparisons assume same rate card version + allocation snapshot.” and if not true, warn.

Alicia Perez: yes. also disable compare by default. too easy to click and misread.

Dylan Brooks: also, if filter state persists, we need a big “Reset” affordance. too many “why is mine different than yours” issues.

Allison Grant: what about saved links? like Finance can send a URL that opens the QTD preset (not your last saved localStorage state).

Felix Schneider: doable: encode filters in query params. when present, params take precedence over localStorage. and if it matches a preset exactly, we can display the preset name.

Chloe Martin: implementation detail: if we keep localStorage restore, we should cap it. like after 7 days, don’t restore stale filters.

Marissa Cole: +1, “stale restore” is a known footgun.

Laura Bennett: also please prevent people from comparing apples/oranges:
- comparing “All tiers” to “Dedicated” and calling it “cost went up”
- comparing a single model to “All models” and missing the mix shift
Could we make the compare selector explicit: “Compare: Same filters, previous period” only, not arbitrary second filter set.

Alicia Perez: we can do “previous period” only in v1. (no custom compare). plus add a line under the chart: “Filters apply to both periods.”

Nora Ahmed: that’s consistent with DES-319 guidance. I’ll add the copy + callouts.

Mei Lin: re: confidence indicator proposal — when we’re missing region/tier coverage, the blended metric is misleading. can we show a banner for Finance preset if completeness < 99% for the selected window?

Allison Grant: yes please. tie to the pipeline completeness checks. even a yellow “Data incomplete (97% coverage)” helps.

Rishi Malhotra: for Finance view, I’d rather show “Data not certified for reporting” when below threshold. and maybe disable export.

Chloe Martin: disable export is UI-only though. but fine for internal.

Felix Schneider: action items I see:
- add Presets dropdown (server-defined list)
- add Reset button
- localStorage restore expiration
- query-param override behavior
- compare mode = previous period only + warn on rate card/snapshot mismatch
- show timezone label in time range selector
- completeness banner (esp on Finance preset)

Talia Benson: can we align on the exact presets for v1 so I can update PM-482/rollout notes?

Marissa Cole: my vote for v1 presets:
1) “Company (Live)” = last 7d, live view, all tiers/models/regions
2) “Finance QTD (PT)” = QTD, finance view (pinned), all tiers/models/regions, compare disabled, export enabled only if completeness >= 99%
3) “SRE Freshness” = last 6h, live view, shows completeness panel expanded

Laura Bennett: works. also can we name it “Finance QTD (PT, Reporting)” so people stop screenshotting the live view into decks.

Dylan Brooks: ok. but keep copy short in the UI; maybe the tooltip explains reporting vs live.

Alicia Perez: I’ll draft labels + tooltip content + the “modified from preset” state. will share in DES-311 thread.

Allison Grant: :thumbsup: once we have presets + reset, I think we’ll cut down on “misread comparison” pings by a lot.

Felix Schneider: I’ll take the presets + URL param override. Chloe/Nora can take reset + modified indicator? (or I can do it if you’re slammed)

Chloe Martin: I can take reset + localStorage expiration.

Nora Ahmed: I’ll take modified indicator + compare-mode copy/warning.

Talia Benson: logging these as follow-ups for ENG-8428 / DES-311. thanks all.

(reacts: Laura Bennett added :thumbsup: to Marissa Cole’s preset proposal)
